title: Teacher representatives gather at the Education Ministry over salary and housing demands
location: Outside the Ministry of Education, Ulaanbaatar
scope: One reported gathering of teacher representatives; wider participation and relationship to other teacher actions are not established.

demands_original: A meaningful salary increase and improved housing access for teachers; further education-budget concerns are described.
participants_original: Teacher representatives; no numeric count or qualitative crowd size.
